Jeff, I've passed you to the team again so a person picks this up today. Someone will get back to you here or at (email hidden)

Two of your returns came in on November 5: the NerdQaxe++ from Shop···· and the Bitaxe from Shop····. The other two still haven't been logged by the warehouse. Those are the NerdQaxe++ for Shop···· and the Bitaxe for Shop····.

(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks Jeff, that helps. USPS shows a box delivered to our Chattanooga warehouse on November 5 at 9:10am.

There's one thing I need to check. The tracking number is cut off at "...····" in the screenshot, and both of your NerdQaxe++ return labels start with those digits. The warehouse logged the Shop···· box that same day.

Could you send the last four digits of that tracking number? It tells the team which return this is. Did you send both NerdQaxe++ units in this one box?
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks Jeff. This UPS one is the Bitaxe return for Shop····, and the warehouse did log it on November 5. The one still missing is the Bitaxe for Shop····, which had its own UPS label ending in ····.

So my guess is you sent both Bitaxes in this one box, and both NerdQaxe++ units in the one USPS box. The warehouse would then have logged only one unit from each box.

Is that right? Did each box have two units in it? If so, I'll pass that to the team so they can find the second unit in each box.
